GEOTHERMAL

Operation & Maintenance Support Services — Salak

Star Energy Geothermal Salak, Ltd. & Salak Pratama, Ltd.

Full operation and maintenance support for one of the world’s largest geothermal fields. TCM places a multidisciplinary team on site to keep the steam production and power generation facilities reliable throughout the three-year contract.

  • Mechanical, electrical & instrumentation, rotating equipment, and civil
  • Scaffolding, welding, machining, and heavy equipment & lifting
  • Material planning & coordination, asset management, SAP and logistics
  • SHE support: emergency response and daily safety supervision
Location: Gunung Salak, SukabumiPeriod: Dec 2024 – Nov 2027Status: Ongoing

Drilling Preparation & Well Hook-Up Construction

Star Energy Geothermal (Wayang Windu) Limited

  • Pipe, valve, and equipment installation; welding and insulation
  • Instrumentation system and electrical cable installation
  • ITP documentation and as-built drawings through to handover
Location: Wayang Windu, West BandungPeriod: Nov 2025 – Nov 2027Status: Ongoing

Oil & Natural Gas

A Long Track Record in Jambi

Since 2009 TCM has operated and maintained the natural gas transmission facilities of PT Energasindo Heksa Karya in Jambi Province — delivering gas to PT PLN (Persero) power plants. Two pipeline sections totalling 47.5 km have been kept reliable without interruption for seventeen years, forming the foundation of TCM’s oil and gas competence.

Period2009–2025

Operation and maintenance of the natural gas transmission line from Tempino Kecil to the PT PLN (Persero) power plant in Payo Selincah. Scope covers gas delivery operations, metering and reporting, routine maintenance of the pipeline and metering facilities, emergency response, and HSE management — TCM’s longest-running contract.

PT Energasindo Heksa Karya

Capacity32.7 MMSCFD

A continuation of the Payo Selincah line, flowing gas to PT PLN (Persero)’s Sei Gelam power plant. Scope includes operating the gas delivery system, metering and monitoring, maintenance of the pipeline and measurement facilities, provision of manpower and equipment, and daily to monthly operational reporting.
